eventDetail.scope: The **International Conference on AI Video Technology and Applications (AIVTA 2026)** focuses on the cutting-edge intersection of artificial intelligence and video technology. It covers a broad range of topics from AI-driven video production and editing, generative AI for creative content, and immersive media applications, to advanced computer vision, visual effects, and real-time virtual production. The conference highlights innovations in AI models, machine learning algorithms, and smart cinematography, with an emphasis on their impact across entertainment, media, and industry applications.
